content: KBMRC also relates to knowledge-base question answering (KBQA) BIBREF23 , which aims to answer questions based on an external large-scale KB such as Freebase or ProBase. KBMRC differs from KBQA in that the original KB comes from the content of a document. External KB is used in this work to enhance the document KB. Moreover, existing benchmark datasets for KBQA such as WebQuestions BIBREF24 are typically limited to simple questions. The KBMRC task requires reasoning over two facts from the document KB.
